exposure: modified World Health Organization (mWHO) risk classification
cohort: 101 women with ACHD (adult congenital heart disease) and 149 pregnancies discussed at multidisciplinary conferences at Lund University Hospital between March 2009 and May 2021
finding: Women with more complex heart disease (mWHO classes III or IV) had a higher rate of cesarean section, premature birth, and FGR compared to women in lower mWHO classes.
mod_finding: Women with mWHO class ≥III underwent cesarean section more often than women in less complex mWHO classes.
